reply_text:
I replied to Pree in a thread on her correction in #central-team, confirming the lane is at Gate 47, not Dock 23.

One problem with that reply: it says "I've updated it," but there was nothing to update. The only record of Dock 23 is my earlier thread reply, and I didn't edit or delete it, so it still shows Dock 23. Anyone who finds that thread on its own will see the wrong site unless they also see her correction.
